subject.title: Show DeepSeek Platform usage with cost summary

question: May Cost summary alone authorize DeepSeek Chrome-session discovery and private Platform usage for existing users who previously disabled Show credits & extra usage?
rationale: The source establishes the changed gate but cannot establish whether the earlier setting was intended as an explicit privacy and browser-session consent boundary for persisted user preferences.

options.title: Retain the existing opt-in
options.body: Keep the credits-and-extras opt-in as a prerequisite for DeepSeek Platform collection, while Cost summary controls only presentation.

options.title: Adopt Cost summary as consent
options.body: Make the new gate intentional only with an explicit upgrade/consent treatment and tests covering persisted settings from existing installs.

recommendation.title: Retain the existing opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep the credits-and-extras opt-in as a prerequisite for DeepSeek Platform collection, while Cost summary controls only presentation.

likelyOwner.reason: Zihao-Qi introduced the merged DeepSeek detailed-usage flow whose activation semantics this follow-up changes.
